SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(f.web_order_id) as order_count,
  SUM(f.order_total_gross) as total_gross
FROM fact_web_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(f.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
  AND f.status IN ('delivered', 'collected', 'processing')

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(f.web_order_id) as order_count,
  SUM(f.order_total_gross) as total_gross,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.order_total_gross) / SUM(SUM(f.order_total_gross)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.fiscal_period), 2) as pct_share
FROM fact_web_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(f.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
  AND f.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.fulfilment_type

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.fulfilment_type,
  SUM(f.order_total_gross) as order_total_gross,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales_line_net
FROM fact_web_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(f.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON f.web_order_id = fsl.receipt_id AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
  AND f.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.fulfilment_type

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
  AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  fsl.channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, fsl.channel_code
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, fsl.channel_code
